reason: Every error class in the framework's *.errors files ends in Error (base.errors.ts, step.errors.ts, signature.errors.ts, agent.errors.ts), and isNativeError in base.errors.ts even relies on the Error suffix; the abstract ResourceExecutionFailed sits beside ResourceConflictError/ResourceNotFoundError and simply missed the suffix. biome.json applies useNamingConvention only to apps/libs, and only checks PascalCase, so nothing enforces this.
